method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Motor Vehicles (Third-Party Risks and Compensation) Act 1960 (Singapore), 2020 Revised Edition, informal consolidation in force from 1 January 2026 (carrying Act 30 of 2024, in force 1 January 2025, and Act 2 of 2025, in force 1 January 2026), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/MVTPRCA1960.txt

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the driver or owner of a motor vehicle. ss 2, 3 (offence, exemptions, employed driver's defence, 12-month disqualification), 3A (presumption of use), 4(1), (4), (9), (11), (12) (what makes cover comply; what a policy need not cover), 5 (passenger agreements and volenti), 7 and 8 (conditions and restrictions of no effect; insurer's recovery), 9 (when the insurer must pay a judgment against me: the gateway, the relevant amount, the Public Trustee route, the four bars, s 9(8), and the s 9(9) claw-back), 10, 12, 13 (bankruptcy), 11 (duty to say whether insured), 14(1) (settlement), 15 (surrender within 7 days), 16 (production, 5-day grace, 24-hour accident report, owner's information), and the penalties in ss 3, 11, 15, 16. The relevant amount ($5,000 in s 2) is an input; no s 20 order is deposited. NOT ENCODED: s 4(2), (3), (5)-(7) (pre-1998 policies; hospital expenses); ss 5A, 6 (settlement agreements); s 9(2)-(5), (10)-(13); s 10(3)-(5); s 11(2)-(5); s 14(2); ss 17, 18, 18A-24 (deposits, solicitation, Public Trustee, power to amend sums, securities, general penalty, exemption, rules).
seat: the driver or owner of a motor vehicle
